latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of juejin-pins-publish.

- Automatically publishes Pins (沸点) to the Juejin community as requested by the user.
- Supports text content, circle (club) selection, topic tags, images, links, and code blocks.
- Follows step-by-step browser automation instructions for interacting with the Juejin Pin publishing interface.
- Provides user guidance for publishing simple Pins, adding circles, topics, images, links, and code.
- Includes troubleshooting tips and links to relevant Juejin pages.
